change.implementation: scripts/backup.mjs indexes validated database entities and requires each asset projectId to resolve to a project; a present sessionId must resolve to a session whose projectId matches the asset
change.boundary: backup creation and restore reject self-consistent asset paths with dangling or cross-project ownership before atomic promotion
change.negativeFixture: a synthetic asset row and local file moved to the deterministic path of a nonexistent project

limitations: This increment validates asset ownership but does not yet validate every relationship among all database entity kinds.
Independent review, off-host retention, staging drills and production rollback remain separately gated.
